messages:
Maria L: noticed a spike of OOMs on a3-gpu-01 after the 14:00 deploy. failures clustered on mixed kv-heavy requests + long context.
Ajay P: can you paste logs?
Maria L: here's one trace:
```
2026-03-12T14:23:08Z ERROR oom allocating KV slice (req=248MB) active_kv=6.1GB host_limit=6.4GB batch_id=0x7fae3e queue_depth=18 avg_len=1024
```
Kevin H: that queue_depth+avg_len is the pathological continuous-batcher case. lots of pinned KV.
Tess: benchbot profile shows kernel selection stayed on fp16 "main" path which needs big temp buffers; compact kernel not chosen.
BenchBot: profile p95: kernel_fp16_main=42ms, kv_merge=18ms, peak_kv=6.3GB
Maria L: repro: 50 concurrent requests kv_size~1200 tokens + small attention mask. OOMs in ~30-40s.
Ajay P: proposed mitigations:
- admission: token-budget cap based on KV headroom (soft)
- shepherding: prioritize small-kv requests
- kernel-fallback: force compact kernel when projected_kv high
Kevin H: local admission sketch:
```
function admit(req):
  projected = active_kv + req.kv_est
  if projected > kv_soft_limit:
    if req.priority=='interactive': return fastpath_override()
    else: return defer()
  return allow()
```
kv_soft_limit = host_limit - 300MB
Tess: compact kernel cuts peak_kv ~28% but increases p99 ~12%.
Maria L: Ajay run two canary variants: A) kv-shepherd (sort by kv_size asc) B) soft-admission (reject when headroom low). measure OOM count + p99.
Ajay P: starting on canary pool tag=kv-shepherd-expt: `./run_shepherd_expt --variant=A --pool=a3-canary-2`
ops-bot: canary deploy completed (deploy-id=20260312-kv-shep)
Kevin H: also add runtime probe: `runtime.compact_kernel_kv_threshold=400MB` to force compact kernel when headroom<400MB.
Tess: 30m into A: OOMs 7->1, p99 slightly better but avg latency +3% due to reordering.
Ajay P: 30m into B: OOMs 0, but 18% requests requeued; interactive timeouts seen. needs fastpath override.
Maria L: decision: ship B with interactive fastpath override when predicted_kv<200MB and add compact-kernel flag at 400MB threshold.
Kevin H: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842 (admission + kernel-flag)
Tess: next: merge to kv-safety branch, 24h canary run, collect benchbot profiles + kernel traces, watch OOM + p99.
Maria L: infra action: create alert host_kv_headroom gauge + alert when headroom<250MB and OOM_rate>0 for 5m.
ops-bot: alert rule created (rule-id=kv_headroom_250_alert)
Maria L: thanks all. follow-up: Ajay please add metrics for rejected_by_kv_admission and compact_kernel_activations.
Ajay P: on it, will push dashboards.
